name: headless-app-tanstack
title: Headless App for TanStack Start
description: A backend your customers can use through their agents: sign-in, OAuth consent, an MCP server, and connected agent management.
docs: Follow https://supabase.com/library/docs/tanstack/headless-app to configure local JWT signing keys, apply the declarative tasks schema, and serve the MCP function. Set `VITE_PRODUCT_NAME`, `VITE_SUPABASE_URL`, and `VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY` in `.env.local`. Open `/agents` to copy the MCP URL, authorize a client, and verify the connection with `whoami`. The server includes list_tasks, create_task, update_task, and delete_task, scoped to the signed-in user through RLS. Merge `supabase/config.toml` with existing project settings before applying it.
